holeBearingsHint: Compass bearings (0-360 deg) per hole, tee to green. Holes 1-4 and 7-18 from OSM golf=hole ways (Black Desert ids 1180722xxx/1186230xxx; the neighbouring course's 1548034xxx ways share refs and were excluded). Holes 5-6 have no hole way in OSM and were taken from tee/green polygon centroids (5: 314yd vs ~315 card, 6: 426yd vs ~445 card). The routing chains tee-to-green for all 18 holes. Hole 3's OSM way is short (132yd vs ~185 card), probably a forward tee, so its bearing is the least certain.
